per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an inference endpoint stores nothing for the caller

egress.terms: the response is the payload; no separate egress term is published

category: inference gateway, community GPU pool, anonymous tier

free_tier.stated: Works without a key, with limits; a free key gives more. /v1/models lists 9 ids on 2026-11-10; the one echo/ id probed answered with no key, and the one other id probed, blue/dealignai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-UNCENSORED-FP8, answered 401 and requires a key; the listing carries a per-model allow_anonymous flag
free_tier.notes: the limits are not stated as numbers on the page; models are served by volunteers sharing their own GPUs

tooling: any OpenAI-compatible client with base URL https://net.beaverai.org/v1
chaining: pairs with prototypes that tolerate a changing set of volunteer-served models; the anonymous tier covers only models flagged allow_anonymous

limits.value: unpublished: the page says works without a key, with limits, and gives no number; GET /v1/models returns no rate-limit header

binding_note: the unpublished anonymous limit is the stated gate, and only some models allow anonymous calls

identity_cost.detail: the page says try it without an account, or sign up with just a name; a GET to /v1/usage, /v1/limits and /v1/chat/completions with no Authorization header answered 401 Missing or invalid Authorization header, so the anonymous route may need a header or token that the page does not show

reliability_note: the model set is small and changes with volunteer availability: the home page counts 4 models available
confidence_note: the claim is first-party and the listing was read by GET; the 401 on keyless GETs to the chat and usage routes conflicts with it, and no completion was sent because probe.py issues GET and HEAD only

evidence.quote: Works without a key, with limits. Get a free key for more.
evidence.proved: the page states the API works without a key, with limits

evidence.quote: Try it without an account, or sign up with just a name.
evidence.proved: an account is optional and a signup needs just a name
the home page lists the count of models available

a keyless POST on 2026-11-10 for echo/huihui-qwen3.8-27b-abliterated answered 200 twice and echoed huihui-qwen3.8-27b-abliterated, the first call with empty content at 32 reasoning tokens and the second with content pong

a keyless POST on 2026-11-10 for blue/dealignai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-UNCENSORED-FP8 answered 401 on both calls with the message that the model requires an API key, in the same probe in which echo/huihui-qwen3.8-27b-abliterated answered 200 twice

notes: whether a keyless POST to /v1/chat/completions answers is unverified
